cover.desc: Full color but nearly monochrome in practice — the pale blue-green of old wet tile, one warm sodium lamp, and steam. High overhead angle, almost architectural: the whole empty bath hall of Kotobuki-yu seen from the ceiling corner, the chipped Mt. Fuji mural running along the far wall, the long grid of floor tiles taking up most of the frame, water sheeting toward the drain channel. Two small figures crouch near the bottom of the image, metres apart, each with a brush, each facing their own patch of floor — Nagi in her indigo happi with her hair clipped up, Itsuki in his green-trimmed jersey with the sleeves shoved back. Neither is looking at the other. Two buckets, two wrung cloths, one pair of rubber sandals kicked off at the edge. The composition is mostly empty floor. It should read as a landscape with two people accidentally in it, and it should feel like the warmest place in the world.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: uncertain, hands in jersey pockets, none of his usual size
chars.pose: standing alone in the middle of the floor, shoes in one hand, not knowing where to put himself

panels.bg: Kotobuki-yu changing room at 11:49pm, all the yellow baskets stacked, entrance sign dark, one warm lamp, the fish clock, the bath door open with steam rolling through it
panels.action: Continuous from last chapter. He is standing in a room he paid four hundred and forty yen to enter three hours ago, and it is a completely different room.

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: already walking away toward the bath hall, towel over one shoulder

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: still standing where he stopped

panels.bg: changing room into the bath doorway, steam, warm lamp behind, cooler light ahead
panels.action: She does not tell him to come in. She does not tell him to go home. She goes back to work.

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: on hands and knees on the wet tile, scrubbing the grout line, trousers rolled

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: quiet, taking in the size of the room
chars.pose: standing in the doorway, one hand on the frame

panels.bg: bath hall, chipped Fuji mural, heavy steam, tile grid running away toward the drain, one overhead lamp
panels.action: From the doorway the room is enormous and she is very small in it.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: working something out, mouth slightly open
chars.pose: watching, absolutely still

panels.bg: steam, blurred tile
panels.action: He watches her do it for a long time. Nobody has ever seen this either.

panels.bg: a red plastic bucket by the wall, four brushes standing handle-up in it, one blue, cloths wrung over the rim
panels.action: His eye finds the spare brushes.

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: both hands on the brush, knuckles split and chemical-red, water running over them

panels.bg: wet tile, flat screentone
panels.action: And then it finds her hands again.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: something settling behind the eyes — decision, not pity
chars.pose: straightening off the doorframe

panels.bg: steam, warm backlight
panels.action: He does not offer. Offering could be refused.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: n/a — hand only, plaster on one finger
chars.pose: hand closing around a brush handle in the bucket

panels.bg: red bucket, wet tile, flat screentone
panels.action: He picks up a brush.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: crouched on the tile an arm's length from her, brush held up

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not looking up, brush not stopping
chars.pose: still scrubbing, head down

panels.bg: bath hall floor, steam, mural behind, drain channel between them
panels.action: First words of the night. Neither of them makes it a moment.

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: crouched, scrubbing, hair clipped up, sleeves past the elbow

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: crouched two metres away, jersey sleeves shoved back, working his own patch

panels.bg: the whole bath hall from the far end — vast tile grid, chipped Fuji mural, heavy steam, one lamp, water sheeting to the drain. Compose so the two figures occupy less than a quarter of the frame.
panels.action: Full page. Two people scrubbing a floor at midnight. This is the image the series is made of.

panels.bg: the fish-shaped clock on the changing room wall, reading 11:56
panels.action: The clock runs four minutes fast. Nobody has ever fixed it.

panels.bg: a single grout line under a brush, grey coming off it, water greying
panels.action: Grout.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: scrubbing one square of tile far too thoroughly

panels.bg: wet tile, steam, mural edge
panels.action: He is doing one tile with the intensity of a man defusing something.

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: scrubbing, eyes flicking toward him and away

panels.bg: wet tile, steam
panels.action: She looks at him once. He does not catch it.

panels.bg: the fish clock, reading 12:15
panels.action: Nineteen minutes of nothing.

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: holding her own brush up and drawing it along the grout at a low angle, twice, deliberately

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: stopped, brush idle

panels.bg: wet tile, steam, low overhead lamp
panels.action: She does not touch him or take his hand. She shows him the angle twice and goes back to her own patch.

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: already scrubbing again

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: brush low, weight forward

panels.bg: wet tile, steam
panels.action: One word of instruction, and one word of him reaching for his old register out of pure reflex.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: nothing. no reaction of any kind.
chars.pose: scrubbing, head down

panels.bg: wet tile, flat screentone
panels.action: The bit dies in the steam. She does not even register that one was attempted.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: caught out, ears hot, grin dissolving
chars.pose: frozen mid-stroke

panels.bg: steam, blurred tile
panels.action: In any room he has ever been in, that would have got a laugh. This room did nothing.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: shoulders coming down two centimetres

panels.bg: steam, warm lamp
panels.action: It turns out that not having to be funny is a thing that can happen to a person.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: crouched, scrubbing properly now

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: crouched, scrubbing, three metres off

panels.bg: bath hall, steam, tile grid, the drain channel running between their two patches
panels.action: He goes back to the floor. The silence stops being a thing he is failing at.

panels.bg: the fish clock, reading 12:34
panels.action: Another nineteen.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: lifting the full water bucket in both hands and carrying it to the drain

panels.bg: bath hall, steam, drain channel, tile
panels.action: He takes the heavy bucket without being asked and without announcing that he has taken it.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: stopped mid-stroke, watching the bucket go
chars.pose: kneeling back on her heels

panels.bg: wet tile, steam
panels.action: For fourteen months there has been nobody to hand the heavy end to.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: already back to work, face hidden
chars.pose: head down, scrubbing hard

panels.bg: wet tile, steam, his back visible in the far corner of the frame
panels.action: She looks away before he turns around.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: carrying the empty bucket back past the counter

panels.bg: the end of the bandai counter, low warm lamp, the changing room dim behind him
panels.action: On the way back past the counter, something catches his eye.

panels.bg: a pair of worn blue rubber sandals on the floor beside the counter, squared up neatly, several sizes larger than anything else in the building, dust in the tread
panels.action: A man's sandals, set out for a man, waiting where they have waited for fourteen months.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: looking at them, bucket still in hand

panels.bg: dim changing room, warm lamp
panels.action: He works out roughly what they are. He asks nothing. He keeps walking.

panels.bg: the fish clock, reading 12:41
panels.action: The fish clock says 12:41.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: n/a — hand and phone screen only
chars.pose: wet hand tilting his phone, screen reading 12:37

panels.bg: dark, phone glow, steam
panels.action: His phone says 12:37. The building is four minutes ahead of the world.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: small private smile, pocketing the phone
chars.pose: looking back up at the fish clock

panels.bg: changing room, warm lamp, fish clock soft-focus behind
panels.action: He puts the phone away and goes with the fish.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: wrecked, eyes half shut, entirely undefended
chars.pose: sitting on the tile edge with her back to the wall, legs out, feet in the shallow water

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: sitting a metre along the same wall, same posture, arms slack on his knees

panels.bg: bath hall, floor finished and gleaming, heavy steam, one lamp, the mural above them
panels.action: Forty minutes. The floor is done. Neither of them moves for a while.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: returning from the cold case with two bottles of milk, setting coins on the counter as he passes

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: watching him do it, saying nothing
chars.pose: still sitting, head against the wall

panels.bg: changing room seen from the bath hall floor, cold case, counter, warm lamp
panels.action: He knows where the milk is now. He still puts the money down. This time it costs nothing.

panels.bg: flat screentone, warm lamp glow
panels.action: Two hands round two cold bottles: hers split and raw, his with the plaster gone soft from the water. Neither hand is hidden.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: standing, stretching his back out

panels.bg: bath hall, finished floor, steam thinning
panels.action: He gets up because there are two children asleep four streets away.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: sliding the blue brush back into the bucket handle-up, exactly the way hers is

panels.bg: red bucket, wet tile
panels.action: He puts the brush back the way she keeps them. He watched, at some point, without either of them noticing.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: eyes on the bucket, something moving behind them
chars.pose: still sitting against the wall

panels.bg: steam, wet tile, warm lamp
panels.action: She notices that he noticed. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: crouched at the entrance pushing his feet into his sneakers

panels.bg: genkan, sandal rack, noren, cold clear night beyond
panels.action: Shoes on. Nothing said. It has been a long time since a night ended without anyone needing anything from him.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: hand flat on the doorframe, back turned — compose to echo Ch.1 page 16 panel 2

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — far off in the bath hall, back turned, wringing a cloth
chars.pose: distant, small, still working

panels.bg: long view from the entrance back through the changing room into the steam, one lamp
panels.action: She says one word from the far end of the building, without looking up, in exactly the voice she uses for instructions.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: one beat of blankness, then it lands — eyes going bright, mouth pulling
chars.pose: hand still on the frame, head down

panels.bg: doorframe, warm light behind, cold night ahead
panels.action: For one panel it could still be an instruction about a floor. Then it isn't. He does not turn around and let her see his face.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: damp-haired, still lit up, easing the door shut
chars.pose: stepping out of his shoes in the genkan at 1:14am

panels.bg: the Nomura apartment entrance, one lamp left on for him, small dark rooms beyond
panels.action: Home. A light left on.

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: awake, textbook shut, waiting up and pretending not to have been
chars.pose: sitting at the kotatsu with her chin on her arms

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: stopped in the doorway

panels.bg: small living room, one lamp, Sōta asleep on a futon in the background
panels.action: She has been up since twelve.

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: flat, gathering her books, not making it a fight
chars.pose: standing up and heading for bed without looking at him

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: the light going out of his face
chars.pose: still in the doorway, hands empty

panels.bg: living room, single lamp, Sōta's futon, the clock reading 1:16
panels.action: The cost, in one line, delivered without accusation, which is what makes it land.

chars.name: gonda
chars.pose: leaning across the aisle, chin out

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: humming, in an unmistakably good mood
chars.pose: tipped back in his chair, feet on the desk rail

panels.bg: Monday classroom, morning light, ordinary noise
panels.action: Monday. Gonda has detected an anomaly.

dialogue.text: You're in a good mood. Why.
I'm always in a good mood.

chars.name: gonda
chars.expression: >_<, magnifying glass, detective cap, tiny body huge head
chars.pose: crawling across the desks in full investigation mode

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: sweating, dot eyes, fending him off with a textbook
chars.pose: leaning away at forty-five degrees

chars.name: aya
chars.pose: watching from two desks away

panels.bg: chaos lines, starburst screentone, sparkle tone
panels.action: Comedy spike, and it is nowhere near the sincere material on purpose.

dialogue.text: No. This is a NEW mood. I know your moods.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: grinning, hands up, giving nothing away
chars.pose: shoving Gonda's face back one-handed

panels.bg: classroom, laughing students
panels.action: He deflects, the way he always has, except this time there is something to deflect from.

dialogue.text: I slept. Once. It was incredible.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: mid-bit, arms out, the whole room watching him
chars.pose: standing on the far side of the classroom performing

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: seated at the window desk, pen moving, not part of any of it

panels.bg: classroom, bright morning light, the width of the room between them
panels.action: Nothing at school has changed. Nothing at school is going to. That was the deal.

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: pushing her left blazer sleeve back off her wrist to write

panels.bg: window desk, morning light across the paper
panels.action: She pushes her sleeve up without thinking about it. Then she thinks about it.

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: left hand flat on the desk in the sunlight, sleeve pushed back, split knuckles plainly visible, pen still

panels.bg: desk, paper, hard morning light, classroom noise implied out of frame
panels.action: She leaves it. Nobody in the room notices, and that is the point. Silent.
